pictures.name: GTH1-Into-The-Night
pictures.prompt: Night in old Jerusalem, about 30 AD. A small group of men in simple robes walks down worn stone steps out of the city toward a dark valley, one oil lamp among them. Leading them, a far figure, Jesus, seen only from behind with his back to the viewer, a man in a plain cream and brown robe with dark shoulder-length hair, his face turned away and completely hidden, never shown even in profile. Deep blue night sky with stars, warm gold lamp glow on the stones. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: GTH2-Olive-Garden
pictures.prompt: Night in an ancient olive garden on a hillside outside Jerusalem, gnarled silver-grey olive trees in moonlight. Peter, a sturdy fisherman in his forties with a grizzled short beard, in a brown wool robe, and James and John, two younger men in their twenties with dark beards, in grey and blue robes, sit down against the trunks. A little way off, walking further into the trees, Jesus, seen only from behind with his back to the viewer, a man in a plain cream and brown robe with dark shoulder-length hair, his face turned away and completely hidden, never shown even in profile. Deep blue moonlight, a faint warm glow from a small lamp on the ground. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: GTH5-Could-You-Not
pictures.prompt: Night in an ancient olive garden. In the near foreground, standing with his back fully to the viewer, Jesus, seen only from behind with his back to the viewer, a man in a plain cream and brown robe with dark shoulder-length hair, his face turned away and completely hidden, never shown even in profile, his shoulders and dark hair dark against the moonlight. Beyond him, facing us, Peter, a sturdy fisherman in his forties with a grizzled short beard, in a brown wool robe, has just woken, rubbing his eyes, looking up with an ashamed face. The others still drowsy. Silver moonlight, warm glow from the low lamp, gentle, not angry. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame.
